topic: Trying a pottery class after work
passage: Last Wednesday, I signed up for a pottery class after work. I had never tried clay before, so I looked up a small studio near the subway and wrote down the address. I finished work at six, packed up my bag, and hurried over to the studio. When I walked in, the teacher smiled and handed me an apron. I put it on, washed my hands, and sat down at a wooden table. She pointed out a lump of soft clay and asked me to press it down with both hands. At first the clay slipped away, and I almost gave up. Then I slowed down, rolled it out, and tried again. After twenty minutes, a small bowl showed up on the wheel. I cleaned up the table, washed off the clay, and took off the apron. The teacher looked over my bowl and praised my first try. I wrapped it up carefully and headed home. I dropped it off on the kitchen shelf and sat down for tea. I smiled, because I had finally tried something new.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录，主弱项继续是过去式 -ed 听辨和短语动词连读，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「下班后去上陶艺课」是全新的文化话题，短文里有 signed/looked/finished/packed/hurried/walked/smiled/handed/washed/pointed/asked/slipped/slowed/rolled/tried/showed/cleaned/praised/wrapped/headed/dropped 等规则过去式；signed up、looked up、wrote down、packed up、hurried over、walked in、put on、sat down、pointed out、pressed down、slipped away、gave up、slowed down、rolled out、showed up、cleaned up、washed off、took off、looked over、wrapped up、dropped off 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
